outgoing.name: Capital
outgoing.excerpt: Banjul is the capital of the Gambia.

outgoing.name: Mosque
outgoing.excerpt: Attractions in the city include the Gambian National Museum, the Albert Market, Banjul State House, Banjul Court House, two cathedrals and several major mosques.

outgoing.name: Palm oil

outgoing.name: Slavery
outgoing.excerpt: In 1816, the British founded Banjul as a trading post and base for suppressing the slave trade.

outgoing.name: United Kingdom
outgoing.excerpt: Banjul is twinned with Grimsby in the UK and Newark,NJ in the United States.
